textos.A divergência central está em como a obr: The central divergence is in how the work holds up: about half of those who recommend it extol the director's aesthetic signature and visual direction. textos.As reviews positivas frequentemente elog: Positive reviews frequently praise Robert Eggers's direction, highlighting his unique approach and the immersive atmosphere he creates in his films.

textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Robert Eg: Released in 2022 and directed by Robert Eggers, The Northman is a 137-minute action, adventure and fantasy production. The story follows a young prince who witnesses the murder of his father and the kidnapping of his mother by his own uncle. Decades later, now a Viking warrior, he decides to fulfill his promise to rescue his mother and avenge his family.
textos.A obra constrói sua narrativa a partir d: The work builds its narrative on a measured, dense cadence, punctuated by rituals and symbols of Norse mythology. The atmosphere relies on a raw setting, integrating rustic natural landscapes with supernatural elements throughout its execution.
textos.Os três grupos concordam sobre o que o f: The three groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~76%), most extol Robert Eggers's auteur direction and signature style. Likewise, a good portion praise the cinematography and the recreation of the period setting, while a significant share emphasize the theme of revenge and the representation of an animal masculinity.
textos.Para quem se posiciona numa parcela das: For those who fall in a share of the ratings (~18%), many report an evident lack of emotional involvement with the characters. In this range, several consider the narrative predictable and full of clichés, although a considerable number make a point of praising the cinematography and the impressive art direction.
textos.Para quem avalia numa fração mínima das: For those who rate in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~6%), about half point to a weak, predictable script as the work's main problem. Within this reading, many criticize the performances as sounding artificial, while a significant share express discomfort with the slow, drawn-out pace of the production.
